coverage.original_language: A selected mathematical-papers modern LaTeX reader draft is front-facing, with publisher collected-volume wrapper pages removed.
coverage.translation: Current English translation reader includes the 1910 invariant-theory note, the 1916 finiteness theorem for invariants of finite groups, the current two-part draft on integral rational representation of invariants, the absolute irreducibility criterion and continuation, formal variational calculus and differential invariants, polynomial ideals and resultants, algebraic and differential invariants, elimination theory, general ideal theory, short reports on abstract ideal theory, Hilbert numbers, group characters, and the opening of abstract ideal theory in algebraic number and function fields.
coverage.proofreading: Working drafts for checking; not certified final critical editions.
